source_contracts: Attack entrypoints override classification size to1001 and use299x299 NHWC inputs.
All backbones execute is_training=False, so moving BN statistics and disabled dropout must be preserved while input differentiation stays enabled.
InceptionV3 auxiliary features come from Mixed_6e; V4 from Mixed_6h; InceptionResnetV2 from PreAuxLogits. create_aux_logits defaults true independently of is_training.
ResNetV2-101 has block unit counts3,4,23,3 with final-unit stride2,2,2,1 and preactivation/postnorm structure; it has no auxiliary logits.
ResNet conv2d_same uses explicit effective-kernel padding, including stride>1; generic strided SAME padding can shift even-sized inputs.
Inception BN scopes specify epsilon0.001/decay0.9997. ResNet specifies epsilon1e-5/decay0.997/scale=True. Unspecified Slim defaults still require explicit dependency characterization.
environment: TensorFlow package absent from matcher venv. No dependency installation performed; Torch adaptations must be independently validated against source semantics.
next: Preserve explicit padding and frozen batch normalization semantics in differentiated primitives.
